lesson.subtitle: Lesson 13 -- The Weekend
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 13 -- The Weekend
lesson.grammar_point: present simple wh- questions with do / does (What do you...? Where do you...?)

listenings.text: Hello everybody, this is Linda, from the Miami office. A quick note about the team beach day. It is on Saturday, at ten in the morning, at Crandon Park. How do you get there? Take a taxi, or go by car. It is twenty minutes from the office. What do you bring? A hat, water, and your family! The food is free. If it rains, we go to the mall, to a restaurant on the second floor. See you on Saturday!

Hi, this is Paul again. In Miami, people love the weekend. What do they do? On Saturday, many people go to the beach, or to a park. On Sunday, families go to the mall, because it is cool inside, and it is very hot outside. Some people have a short trip to Key West. It is three hours by car. My advice: say yes to one invitation. A Saturday with the team is better than ten meetings.

extra_audio.text: It is Friday afternoon in the Miami office. Amy asks: what do you do on the weekend? I say: on Saturday, I go to the gym. Then she asks: are you free on Saturday? I say yes, and I go to the beach with the team.
